_anchors.tones.perMaterial: 5, the established house range; the body spends it across cloth, metal and mask.
_anchors.light.x: -0.48, the room's upper-left service lamp and the established shelf direction.
_anchors.light.y: -0.7, high enough to separate the mask brow and both coat shoulders.
_anchors.light.z: -0.34, toward the viewer so the pale mask remains a readable face.
_anchors.light.curve: 1.2, broad midtones for aged cloth and brass without flattening either material.
_anchors.outline.enabled: true, the selected house idiom and necessary against the dark chamber.
_anchors.outline.material: ink, shared blue-black with the orrery chamber and its mechanical seams.
_anchors.outline.inner: true because coat, mask, boots and metal trim are physically separate pieces.
_anchors.outline.rim: false, settled by the project's ink comparison and unchanged here.
_anchors.body.scale: 1.14 gives a 42 pixel standing body inside a room whose walkways are 8 pixels thick.
_anchors.texture.speckle: 0, retired by the project's visual verdict; small bodies cannot carry random texture.
_anchors.texture.dither: 0, the keeper has no single-owner 4 by 4 surface large enough for a stable weave.
_anchors.texture.lattice: 2, unused while body dither is zero but kept explicit for the shared parameter contract.
_anchors.texture.facet: 0, cloth and a smooth mask are not the arena's flat-shaded armour.
_anchors.shadow.steps: 7, one step beyond the mask and coat's deepest overlapping mass.
_anchors.shadow.bias: 0.25, project-wide acne guard since the seventh authoring run.
_anchors.shadow.strength: 2 ramp steps, enough to separate near limbs without turning the coat black.
_anchors.fill.x: 0.5, opposite the upper-left key and inherited from the shelf's lighting rig.
_anchors.fill.y: 0.2, low chamber bounce from the brass floor mechanisms.
_anchors.fill.z: -0.2, a weak frontal return that keeps the visor edge visible.
_anchors.fill.weight: 0.13, restrained so bone-white highlights remain the brightest body pixels.
_anchors.canvas.w: 56 pixels contains the widest running stride plus the eight-pixel trailing strap.
_anchors.canvas.h: 60 pixels contains the 42-pixel body and four clear rows below every boot outline.
_anchors.canvas.originX: 28, the horizontal centre; facing is produced by the engine's two-render contract.
_anchors.canvas.originY: 39 places the boot contact at row 51 with five rows of safe margin.
_anchors.frames.walk: 8 frames gives two readable contacts per stride and divides the 720 millisecond cycle.
_anchors.gait.swing: 0.115 turns maps a full normalized run key to 41 degrees at the hip.
_anchors.gait.lift: 2.8 pixels gives a one-pixel rendered breath and a three-pixel running rebound.
_anchors.gait.depth: 5 pixels matches the coat half-depth and is reserved for later depth actions.
_anchors.gait.roll: 0 turns because every keeper action stays in the screen plane.
_anchors.playback.msPerFrame: 90 milliseconds makes an eight-frame run cover 720 milliseconds.
_anchors.playback.scale: 4, the bench and contact-sheet enlargement only; the game owns display scale.
